reason: I buy whatever energy drink is in a 4-pack deal at the station shop, usually 30-something crowns a can. 55 CZK for 330 ml is more than a full-size Monster, it's online or in cafés I don't go to, so it just isn't on my route or in my budget logic.
objection: It costs more than Red Bull and gives me less drink than a big Monster. Natural ingredients don't matter much to me when I'm paying per can.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the station shop or supermarket on a multipack offer that brings it down to about 35-40 CZK a can.
